answer.rationale: The latency climb follows a release by roughly 30 minutes during write-heavy peak traffic, making the release the most actionable suspected regression. Rollback is the most reversible single intervention and inherited evidence indicates the prior build was stable and a previous rollback cleared a checkout error spike without customer impact. The peak load may also contribute, so causality is not yet certain; verify the archived rollback record before committing and preserve write durability throughout the rollback.
